hooks.name: Regenerate fixtures on profile or generator change
hooks.description: When a card profile in public/profiles/ or scripts/make_fixtures.ts is saved, regenerate tests/fixtures/ and fail loudly if any PNG changed. Shell command only, no agent prompt.

action.command: sh -c 'sh .kiro/hooks/bin/check-fixtures.sh; s=$?; node scripts/log_hook.ts "Regenerate fixtures on profile or generator change" "exit $s"; exit $s'
